about: u runs right, v runs down from the top of a wall, metres. Each stone's footprint is where it meets the mortar, eight corners round, broken at its own corners; the mortar is everything outside the footprints, 40 mm behind the wall's face. Its face is the ring inside its bevel, standing out from the mortar by the rise at its corners, and crowned in the middle by the crown at the point given. A stone whose footprint passes u = 3 wraps round to the left edge.
